s1.quote: Batu Bolong Advanced only Strongest, fully exposed Pelagics, sharks, rays, Mola Year-round 30 min 30 m

highlights.text: Pelagics, sharks, rays and Mola mola

hazards.text: Strongest, fully exposed current of Nusa Penida sites

s1.quote: Labyrinth Advanced · Dramatic Rock Maze · Swell & Surge Just around the corner from Manta Point, Labyrinth is a jumble of huge rock pillars and boulders – some over 15 m tall

highlights.text: Rock pillars forming tunnels and passages

s1.quote: Jack Point … This dive site is an impressive wall that is famous for the big green soft corals … The massive overhangs and crevasses … Maximum depth: 40+ meters

s2.quote: Jack's point: This is a corner where the reef forms a small edge around 30 meters and then continues down much deeper.

highlights.text: Big green soft corals; overhangs and crevasses

s1.quote: Wairterang … Lying between 12 and 33 meters, it is now largely covered with coral and is home to a great diversity of underwater life.

s2.quote: Wairterang Wreck Off Wairterang beach 12 to 33 m Easy to intermediate Second World War freighter, dived from the shore, critters in the sand alongside

highlights.text: Groupers, trevally, lionfish on the wreck

summary.text: A Second World War ship lying off Wairterang beach in Maumere Bay at roughly 12-33 m, largely coral-covered. It can be dived from shore, has no penetration, and the nearby sand is good for muck-style critters.

sites.name: The Crack at Pulau Babi

s1.quote: The Crack, famous for the scar left in the reef by the 1992 earthquake. From the surface to 15 meters deep, the reef has been split and widened, forming a small cave.

s2.quote: The Crack Pulau Babi 5 to 30 m Intermediate The 1992 earthquake fissure, plus a wall of sea fans, sponges and sea squirts

highlights.text: Sea fans, sponges and sea squirts

summary.text: A reef on Pulau Babi split open by the 1992 Flores earthquake, leaving a fissure and small cave in the wall. Divers look down into the crack rather than enter it, over walls of sea fans and sponges.

sites.depthNote: Fissure itself at roughly 18-20 m per Neptune

s1.quote: Sabolon Kecil … Large schools of Chevron Barracudas, Bigeye Trevallies and Batfish can be observed enjoying the split current north of the pinnacle

highlights.text: Shallow reef top, healthy coral, white sand

s1.quote: Sabolon Besar … The sloping reef is encrusted in huge sponges which are often home to Scorpionfish, Batfish and all kinds of reef life.

highlights.text: Sponge-covered sloping reef with scorpionfish, batfish

sites.name: Wakatobi House Reef

s1.quote: House Reef … At it’s outer edge, the reef drops abruptly from depths of less than two meters to more than 40 … mild to medium currents can run along the outer reef slope during tide changes.

s2.quote: Wakatobi’s … the reef crest begins just two meters from the surface and plunges to depths of more than 70 meters.

highlights.text: Wall with overhangs, turtles, hard and soft corals

summary.text: A shore-accessible fringing reef in front of the Wakatobi resort: shallow coral flats about 70 m wide, then a wall falling past 40 m. Mild currents along the slope make drift dives easy, and critters fill the shallows.

sites.depthNote: Crest ~2 m; wall past 40 m (Wakatobi) to 70+ m (DIVER)
